# Kantipur Carpets

> Hand-knotted Nepalese carpets from Kathmandu workshops — wool, silk, hemp, nettle, and natural fibres.

Kantipur Carpet Craft Industries (K.C.C.I) weaves carpets on its own looms in Kathmandu, Nepal. The site is an editorial catalogue and enquiry channel — not an e-commerce checkout.

## Primary pages

- Home: /en
- Heritage & craft: /en/heritage
- Collection (catalogue): /en/collection
- Custom commissions: /en/custom
- Contact & enquiries: /en/contact

Locales: English (/en), Arabic (/ar), French (/fr), German (/de).

## What we make

- Hand-knotted carpets and rugs
- Natural and blended fibres: wool, silk, hemp, nettle, bamboo, linen, pashmina, banana
- Standard collection pieces and bespoke commissions (size, colour, motif, knot grade)
- Workshop visits in Kathmandu by appointment

## How to enquire

- Contact form: /en/contact
- WhatsApp (floating button on site)
- Email enquiries handled via the contact form

## Standards

- Hand-knotted in Kathmandu workshops (not outsourced)
- Child-labour-free production; GoodWeave-aligned ethical standards
- Export-quality finishing

## Company

- Name: Kantipur Carpet Craft Industries / Kantipur Carpets
- Location: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Production: 200+ looms, 1,200+ weavers (as stated on site)

- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Robots: /robots.txt
